scope: Five fresh whole-video runs per scene policy on one original 60-second synthetic two-speaker fixture. Descriptive results, not a guarantee for long videos or native-listening quality.

fixture.source: original text synthesized locally with macOS say
lines: Welcome back. Today we will build a small machine learning project on this laptop.
Before we start, please save a copy of the data. Do not delete the original file.
We have twenty examples for training and five separate examples for testing.
Why do we need a separate test set? Because memorizing the training data is not enough.
If the result is wrong, check the labels first. Then change one setting at a time.
That makes sense. Let us compare the results and explain what changed.

method.process: fresh engine and local job/line/take caches; OS/model file caches warm from pilot runs
method.calibration: Identical recorded voice pace and overhead in all ten runs
method.models: Same pinned local models; unchanged Opus-medium translator and Sonnet-high reviewer, prompt and candidate counts; no fallbacks
method.network: macOS outbound sandbox permits localhost proxy only; proxy tunnels only allowed Anthropic hosts. No audio upload.
method.provider_variance: Claude generation, review/retranslation decisions and provider prompt cache vary. All completed formal runs retained, including imperfect and slower ones.
method.statistic: p50=median; p95=linear interpolation; five samples are descriptive only
method.pilots_reason: Unseeded calibration; baseline pilot lacked thermal/power recording
method.reporting_revision: The series began while test fixtures and final display-flag reporting were being repaired. This final-label fix does not alter working plans, synthesis, scheduling or PCM keys; per-run commit/diff fingerprints are retained.
method.first_take_definition: Time from RenderJob.run start to its first retained _keep take; excludes model loading; not final playable PCM or playback startup. Pipeline time includes all render stages through export, also excluding model loading.

(version 1)
(allow default)

(allow network-outbound (remote unix-socket))
network_audit.scope: Proxy lifetime also includes the two preliminary whole-video pilots; boundary check is separate and text-only

limitations: One short synthesized fixture, not representative long-video throughput.
Integration source contains two non-authored ASR tail units (9 and10); reviewers treated them inconsistently. Independent authored-content inspection distinguishes these.
Automated C and deterministic correction classes do not prove naturalness, pronunciation or speaker similarity. No native human listening performed.
More scene calls and reviews can increase usage and long-tail latency; full raw outputs, costs and timing are retained.
